# Appendix A: Bash Syntax Cheat Sheet

Quick reference covering:
* Shebang & Strict Mode: `#!/usr/bin/env bash`, `set -euo pipefail`
* Quoting: `'literal'`, `"expanded"`, `$'escape'`
* Test Operators: `[[ -f file ]]`, `[[ -d dir ]]`, `[[ -z str ]]`, `[[ -n str ]]`, `(( a > b ))`
* Parameter Expansions: `${var:-def}`, `${var:=def}`, `${var#prefix}`, `${var%suffix}`
* Arrays: `arr=(a b)`, `"${arr[@]}"`, `${#arr[@]}`
* Traps: `trap cleanup EXIT`
